title: A novel boron–nitrogen intumescent flame retardant coating on cotton with improved washing durability

conditions_locator: Materials and finishing pp 3–4, lines 124–178; TGA and LOI methods p 4, lines 187–203
source_location: Complete official 17-page accepted manuscript PDF. Methods pp 3–4; Table 2 spans pp 12–13; Figure 7 distinguishes post-LOI chars; Table 1 is neat polymer TGA and excluded; references pp 15–17. Relevant method/table pixels inspected.
pairing_evidence: The same initial textile rows in Table 2 contain T10%, residue at 500 °C and measured LOI. The adjacent LOI after 5 launderings column is a distinct durability result and is not paired to the initial TGA. Both rows are discussed as cotton fabrics in the thermal stability section.
limitations: Official institutional author accepted manuscript explicitly tied to the journal DOI, not claimed to be the version of record. Two bounded prepared fabric states proposed; independent source QA remains required. PEIPA-only cotton is held for a 33.8 wt% add-on in abstract/LOI prose versus 33.4 wt% in vertical-burning/cone/conclusion passages. Crosslinked cotton has 30 wt% total add-on in its own LOI discussion, but exact bath concentrations, wet pickup, 3:1 synthesis quantities and an additional final curing step are not reported. The 15 wt% PEIPA plus 15 wt% NeoFR split is explicitly reported for cone calorimetry and kept separate from canonical TG/LOI preparation. NeoFR synthesis is referred to prior Yang papers; no unavailable recipe is imported. Table 2 Tmax values remain source-native rather than canonical because the explicit fastest-weight-loss definition appears in the earlier neat-polymer section; T10 and R500 independently support the pair. R500 for control is explicitly the numerical zero in Table 2, not derived from a graph or almost-complete wording. TGA gas flow, pan, extra conditioning and replication are unreported. SI listed by the publisher comprises two MP4 files; no numerical supplement was retrieved. No neat-polymer, TGIR or cone values are substituted. Earlier NeoFR papers are future control-reuse review targets; their original numeric tables have not been retrieved and no reuse absence is asserted.
sample_state: Control cotton, initial before durability laundering
washing_state: Water-scoured and tumble-dried control; no durability laundering assigned
treatment_method: Start with desized, scoured and bleached plain-weave pure cotton, further scour with water and tumble-dry. Water-scouring and tumble-drying conditions are not stated.

sample_state: PEIPA 3:1/NeoFR cotton, 30 wt% total add-on, before durability laundering
washing_state: Initial after two-step coating and drying; before durability laundering
treatment_chemistry: Boron/nitrogen polymer PEIPA 3:1 crosslinked with a vinyl-containing phosphorus/nitrogen compound named NeoFR
treatment_method: Further water-scour and tumble-dry the purchased cotton. First dissolve a source-unspecified amount of NeoFR in 100 mL deionized water, immerse fabric for 1 min, pad using a FANYUAN laboratory Wringer/padder to the desired but unreported wet add-on, and dry at 65 °C for 30 min. Then apply PEIPA 3:1 by the same dipping method described for PEIPA 1:1: acetone solution, repeated dipping as the fabric dries rapidly in air; three dips absorb about 10 mL, followed by drying at 60 °C for 30 min. Source LOI discussion assigns a 30 wt% total add-on. Exact coating bath concentrations, component split for TG/LOI and any additional final cure are not specified.
source_PEIPA_synthesis_route: General PEIPA route uses branched PEI molecular weight 1200, 4-bromophenylboronic acid and triethylamine in THF under nitrogen, stirred at 60 °C and 400 rpm for 24 h; filter, vacuum-evaporate THF at 50 °C and wash with ethyl acetate. The stated synthesis series is EI:PA 1:1, 2:1, 4:1 and 8:1; later finishing explicitly selects 3:1 but does not give its separate reagent quantities. No quantities are derived.
source_cone_component_split: Separate cone-test passage: 15 wt% PEIPA 3:1 and 15 wt% NeoFR; not silently assigned as a measured split to Table 2 TG/LOI.
